text:
Predicates:
FinancialAid(x) ::: x receives financial aid.
ProvesHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
SingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
FewResources(x) ::: x has few resources available.
LivingInSingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
DadOutOfWork(x) ::: x's dad has been out of work.
ApplyingForGRE(x) ::: x is applying to take the GRE test.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.

Premises:
ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants who prove economic hardship.
LivingInSingleParentFamily(Tom) ∧ DadOutOfWork(Tom) ∧ FewResources(Tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family, his dad has been out of work, and he has few resources.
Tom(x) ∧ ApplyingForGRE(x) ::: Tom is applying to take the GRE test.

Conclusion:
FinancialAid(Tom) ::: ETS provides financial aid to Tom.
